claude_proposed_widenings.name: chain_target_selection
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Chain Lightning selects one primary target at full range (150 ft), then selects up to N secondary targets each constrained to within 30 ft of the primary. All targets (primary + secondaries) take the same save-gated effect simultaneously. The existing TargetSelection variants ('one' and 'choose_up_to') have no notion of primary/secondary tiers and no spatial constraint between targets. A new variant is needed — e.g. { mode: 'chain'; secondary: { count: SlotScaling<number>; withinFeetOfPrimary: number } } — to express this hub-and-spoke targeting structure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets of your choice, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: scale_chain_bolt_count
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Higher-level casting adds one secondary bolt per slot level above 6. Once a chain_target_selection variant exists, this scaling maps cleanly to the existing SlotScaling<number> shape on the secondary count field. No new scaling atom is needed — scale_target_count covers it — but the chain variant must exist first to host the per-slot progression.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: One additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above 6.
